ios.desc:
Turn your shortcuts into Live Activities on your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island.

Live Shortcut puts the information from your automations where you can see it. Create a quick note in the app, or use Apple Shortcuts to display text from your own workflows.

YOUR SHORTCUTS, AT A GLANCE
Keep a reminder in sight, show a workflow result, or display a message when an automation runs.

BUILT AROUND YOUR ROUTINE
Choose what appears and when using your own Shortcuts automations. For example, display a garage-door reminder after your shortcut checks whether the door is open.

MAKE IT YOURS
Personalize your Live Activities with icons and color themes. Support for triggering another shortcut helps connect the next step in your workflow.

MORE WITH PREMIUM
Unlock additional customization, custom and built-in icons, multiple Live Activities, and control over which activities to end using identifiers.

Create your first Live Activity and put your shortcuts in sight.

Requires iOS 16.4 or later. Dynamic Island requires a compatible iPhone. Live Activity duration and visibility are managed by iOS. Some features require Premium.
